entities.summary: Tess Osonye Onwueme (b. 1955-09-08, Ogwashi-Uku) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ogwashi-Uku and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, poets & playwrights, africa.
